youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用觀星情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從查天氣挑暗夜地點、備齊望遠鏡與保暖裝備、開車到郊外架好器材，到認北極星與星座、看流星與月球隕石坑、用天文App找土星環，最後夜深收攤、躺看銀河輕聲道晚安，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Stargazing phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), following a whole night under the stars: checking the weather and picking a dark-sky spot, packing the telescope and warm layers, driving out and setting up, finding the North Star and the constellations, watching meteors, the Moon and Saturn's rings with an astronomy app, then staying warm, taking a photo and whispering good night. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the clouds gone yet?
dialogue.zh: 烏雲散掉了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sky is finally clear.
dialogue.zh: 天空終於放晴了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we drive out tonight?
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚可以開出去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's leave right after dinner.
dialogue.zh: 吃過晚飯就出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the weather app say?
dialogue.zh: 天氣App怎麼說？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No clouds after nine tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚九點之後沒有雲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any sign of rain later?
dialogue.zh: 晚點會下雨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zero rain, and light wind too.
dialogue.zh: 不下雨，風也很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a perfect night then.
dialogue.zh: 那今晚再適合不過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the meteor shower starts tonight.
dialogue.zh: 而且今晚有流星雨，正要開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we go this time?
dialogue.zh: 這一次我們去哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The old reservoir road, maybe.
dialogue.zh: 也許走水庫那條舊路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it dark enough there?
dialogue.zh: 那邊夠黑嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No streetlights for ten whole miles.
dialogue.zh: 方圓十英里沒有路燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the moon? When does it rise?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə muːn? wɛn dʌz ɪt raɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 月亮呢？幾點升起？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just past midnight, so we have hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst pæst ˈmɪdˌnaɪt, soʊ wi hæv ˈaʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 月亮剛過午夜才升，我們還有好幾個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Half the night stays dark.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，半個夜晚都是黑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A late moon is a watcher's gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə leɪt muːn ɪz ə ˈwɑtʃərz ɡɪft./
dialogue.zh: 很晚才升起的月亮，才是給觀星人的禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we ask Sam to come?
dialogue.zh: 要不要找Sam一起來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He owns a real telescope, remember.
dialogue.zh: 記得嗎，他有一台真正的望遠鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call him, but keep it short.
dialogue.zh: 打給他，但長話短說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says yes, and brings chairs.
dialogue.zh: 他說好，還要帶椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the bag. What goes in?
dialogue.zh: 現在收包包，放什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm layers, and thick socks.
dialogue.zh: 保暖的內搭層，還有厚襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hat too? That feels silly.
dialogue.zh: 也要帽子？有點誇張吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out here, nine o'clock gets cold fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt hɪr, naɪn əˈklɑk ɡɛts koʊld fæst./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，晚上九點一下子就變冷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will grab my big wool one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ɡræb maɪ bɪɡ wʊl wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我來拿我那頂大毛線帽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And gloves with open fingers.
dialogue.zh: 還有那種露手指的手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need food out there?
dialogue.zh: 那邊需要帶吃的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Popcorn, and one flask of cocoa.
dialogue.zh: 爆米花，還有一壺熱可可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A thermos works better than that.
dialogue.zh: 保溫瓶比水壺更好用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine. I will fill it now.
dialogue.zh: 好，我現在就裝滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Red flashlight. Where is mine?
dialogue.zh: 紅光手電，我的在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The drawer by the front door.
dialogue.zh: 在大門旁邊的抽屜裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why red, though? Explain it.
dialogue.zh: 為什麼要用紅色？說說理由。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps your night vision sharp.
dialogue.zh: 它會讓你的夜視一直保持敏銳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: White light ruins that, right?
dialogue.zh: 白光會破壞夜視，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. One second of white does it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs. wʌn ˈsɛkənd əv waɪt dʌz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，白光一下子就把夜視弄壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Binoculars or the scope first?
dialogue.zh: 先用雙筒還是望遠鏡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Binoculars. They show a wide sky.
dialogue.zh: 先雙筒，看到的天空更寬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will wipe the lenses clean.
dialogue.zh: 我把鏡片擦乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the cloth. And mind the small caps.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə klɔθ. ænd maɪnd ðə smɔl kæps./
dialogue.zh: 用軟布擦。還有，小鏡蓋要小心收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tripod legs feel a bit sticky here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtraɪpɑd lɛɡz fil ə bɪt ˈstɪki hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 三腳架的腳有點卡，拉不太開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open them one at a time.
dialogue.zh: 一次只拉開一枝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Extra memory card? Got one.
dialogue.zh: 備用記憶卡？我有一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Night photos eat space.
dialogue.zh: 好，夜拍很佔空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bug spray. Is it on the list?
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌɡ spreɪ. ɪz ɪt ɑn ðə lɪst?/
dialogue.zh: 防蚊液在清單上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Last line, next to the matches.
dialogue.zh: 最後一行，就在火柴旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Matches? Are we making a fire?
dialogue.zh: 火柴？我們要生火嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No. There is no wood out there.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ. ðɛr ɪz noʊ wʊd aʊt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 不是，那邊沒有木頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then why bring them at all?
dialogue.zh: 那為什麼還是要帶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the lantern, just in case.
dialogue.zh: 以防要點營燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You think of everything, I see.
dialogue.zh: 我看你什麼都先想到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I learned that from cold nights.
dialogue.zh: 那是我從幾個冷夜學來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the mat under the chairs.
dialogue.zh: 墊子鋪在椅子底下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The grass there is damp at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡræs ðɛr ɪz dæmp æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那邊的草入夜後會返潮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two blankets, one for lying down.
dialogue.zh: 兩條毯子，一條躺著蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one for your shoulders, yes.
dialogue.zh: 還有一條披肩膀，對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our chairs. Sam brings his own.
dialogue.zh: 椅子我們帶，Sam帶他自己的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They fold flat. That helps a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ foʊld flæt. ðæt hɛlps ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 它們能壓平，超方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check the gas before we go.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts tʃɛk ðə ɡæs bɪˈfɔr wi ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 出發前看一下油量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nearly full. We are fine.
dialogue.zh: 幾乎是滿的，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the map shows a road north.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə mæp ʃoʊz ə roʊd nɔrθ./
dialogue.zh: 你看，地圖上北邊有一條小路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it slow. It is not paved.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt sloʊ. ɪt ɪz nɑt peɪvd./
dialogue.zh: 開慢點，那是未鋪的土路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Download the map first, then.
dialogue.zh: 那就先把地圖下載下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is no signal up there.
dialogue.zh: 上面沒有手機訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the drive?
dialogue.zh: 開車要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hour, if the road is kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈaʊər, ɪf ðə roʊd ɪz kaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 路順的話，大約一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will drive. You watch turns.
dialogue.zh: 我開車，你注意轉彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will call every turn out loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kɔl ˈɛvri tɜrn aʊt laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 每個彎我會唸出聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keys, phone, wallet. All here?
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙、手機、錢包，都帶了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The spare key hangs on its hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə spɛr ki hæŋz ɑn ɪts hʊk./
dialogue.zh: 備用鑰匙掛在門邊的鉤子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Now lock the front door.
dialogue.zh: 好，現在把大門鎖上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. The trunk is open now.
dialogue.zh: 鎖好了，後車廂打開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Load the boxes on top, please.
dialogue.zh: 把盒子放在最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing heavy on the glass.
dialogue.zh: 玻璃件上面別壓重的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sky over town still looks gray.
dialogue.zh: 城鎮上方的天空還是灰濛濛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: City glow. It hides weak stars.
dialogue.zh: 那是光暈，會吃掉暗星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it look different out there?
dialogue.zh: 在那邊看起來會不一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very. You will not believe it.
dialogue.zh: 差很多，你會不敢相信。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start the engine. Let us roll.
dialogue.zh: 發車，我們出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seatbelt first. Then you may go.
dialogue.zh: 先繫安全帶，才準你出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the radio low tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚收音機小聲一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I want to hear the road instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə hɪr ðə roʊd ɪnˈstɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我想專心聽路的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look. The streetlights stop here.
dialogue.zh: 看，路燈到這裡就斷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dark is closing in around us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɑrk ɪz ˈkloʊzɪŋ ɪn əˈraʊnd ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 黑暗正從四周圍過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes already feel calmer.
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛已經安靜下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give them twenty minutes more.
dialogue.zh: 再給它們二十分鐘適應。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow down. Something crossed ahead.
dialogue.zh: 慢一點，前面有東西衝過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A deer. They own this road.
dialogue.zh: 是只鹿，這條路是牠們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We made it. Kill the headlights.
dialogue.zh: 到了，關掉大燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Silence too. Turn off the engine.
dialogue.zh: 也安靜下來，把引擎關了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the sky is all ours.
dialogue.zh: 現在整片天空都是我們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unpack slowly. We have time.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢卸東西，時間還早。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cocoa first, then the hard work.
dialogue.zh: 先喝熱可可，再開始忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cups. I will hold the lid.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kʌps. aɪ wɪl hoʊld ðə lɪd./
dialogue.zh: 兩杯，我幫你扶壺蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit where the ground is hardest.
dialogue.zh: 就坐在地面最硬的那一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right. I will clear the stones first.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt. aɪ wɪl klɪr ðə stoʊnz fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 好，我先清掉小石子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And that low glow to the south?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðæt loʊ ɡloʊ tə ðə saʊθ?/
dialogue.zh: 那南邊那片低低的光是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A town far off. Ignore it tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə taʊn fɑr ɔf. ˌɪɡˈnɔr ɪt təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 遠處的小鎮，今晚別管它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam is waving from the road.
dialogue.zh: Sam在路邊朝我們揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He parked closer than we did.
dialogue.zh: 他停得比我們還靠近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Help me set the tripod level.
dialogue.zh: 幫我把三腳架架平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use your phone as a small guide.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz jɔr foʊn æz ə smɔl ɡaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 用手機當水準儀看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My screen is too bright here.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡我的螢幕太亮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red mode. Then hold it flat.
dialogue.zh: 調成紅光模式，再拿平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All three legs are locked in now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl θri lɛɡz ɑr lɑkt ɪn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 三隻腳都已經卡進定位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the head goes on top.
dialogue.zh: 接著把雲台裝在最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tighten this screw by hand.
dialogue.zh: 這顆螺絲用手鎖緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, do not strip it.
dialogue.zh: 小心，別把螺紋弄壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the tube sit?
dialogue.zh: 鏡筒該放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dovetail clicks in the middle.
dialogue.zh: 燕尾槽在正中會卡一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It holds. There is no shake.
dialogue.zh: 卡住了，完全不會晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A shake blurs every star.
dialogue.zh: 一晃，星星就糊掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which part is the eyepiece?
dialogue.zh: 哪一個才是目鏡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one marked twenty. Try that.
dialogue.zh: 標二十那顆目鏡，先用它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why the lower power first?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼先用低倍率？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You find things faster that way.
dialogue.zh: 那樣找東西快得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I aimed at a bright dot.
dialogue.zh: 我先把鏡口對準一個亮點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look with one eye, not both.
dialogue.zh: 閉上一隻眼，不要兩眼都睜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it is! A fuzzy patch.
dialogue.zh: 看到了！一團模糊的光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Focus slowly with that wheel.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢轉旁邊的對焦輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it is a swarm of blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt ɪz ə swɔrm əv blu./
dialogue.zh: 現在變成一群藍色的星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The Pleiades. Seven sisters.
dialogue.zh: 是昴星團，七姊妹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their names came from a story.
dialogue.zh: 這些名字來自一個故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old stories live in skies like this.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ˈstɔriz lɪv ɪn skaɪz laɪk ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 古老的故事，就活在這樣的夜空裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you show me the north?
dialogue.zh: 可以帶我找到北方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the bowl in the dipper.
dialogue.zh: 沿著北斗的勺口看過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You mean the spoon with seven stars?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju min ðə spun wɪð ˈsɛvən stɑrz?/
dialogue.zh: 你是說那把有七顆星的勺子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The two up at its rim point north.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tu ʌp æt ɪts rɪm pɔɪnt nɔrθ./
dialogue.zh: 勺口外緣那兩顆，正指向北方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I drew the line in my head.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dru ðə laɪn ɪn maɪ hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我在心裡把那條線畫好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow it. There, small and still.
dialogue.zh: 順著看，那裡，小而安靜的那顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the north star, then?
dialogue.zh: 那就是北極星了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It holds still all night long.
dialogue.zh: 整整一夜它都不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the whole sky turns around it.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə hoʊl skaɪ tɜrnz əˈraʊnd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 所以整個天空都繞著它轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, like a slow white wheel.
dialogue.zh: 對，像一個緩慢的白色圓盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam, your scope points too high right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm, jɔr skoʊp pɔɪnts tu haɪ raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: Sam，你的望遠鏡抬得太高了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me loosen it one notch.
dialogue.zh: 我鬆一格，讓它低一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His tripod is taller than ours.
dialogue.zh: 他的三腳架比我們的還高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here on this flat ground, that is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɑn ðɪs flæt ɡraʊnd, ðæt ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 在這種平地上，沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First we line it up with north.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst wi laɪn ɪt ʌp wɪð nɔrθ./
dialogue.zh: 先把它對準正北方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We call it polar alignment. Then motors track.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kɔl ɪt ˈpoʊlər əˈlaɪnmənt. ðɛn ˈmoʊtərz træk./
dialogue.zh: 這叫極軸對準，接著馬達會自動追蹤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tracking keeps the star in view?
dialogue.zh: 追蹤是把星星留在視野裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The motors do that for us.
dialogue.zh: 馬達幫我們做這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me try the wide eyepiece.
dialogue.zh: 讓我換那顆廣角目鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is for big shapes.
dialogue.zh: 那顆專看大圖形。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Orion is low but rising now.
dialogue.zh: 獵戶還在低處，正在爬升。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Find the three stars in a row.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪnd ðə θri stɑrz ɪn ə roʊ./
dialogue.zh: 先找那三顆排一線的星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His belt is easy to see.
dialogue.zh: 他的腰帶很好認。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His sword hangs under the middle.
dialogue.zh: 他的寶劍掛在中間下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That smudge is a nebula?
dialogue.zh: 那團模糊的是星雲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Baby stars are born in it.
dialogue.zh: 還只是嬰兒的星星在裡面出生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can see four tiny dots.
dialogue.zh: 我看到四顆好小的點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A cluster of young stars there.
dialogue.zh: 那裡是一團年輕的星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that red shoulder a dying star?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt rɛd ˈʃoʊldər ə ˈdaɪɪŋ stɑr?/
dialogue.zh: 那顆紅色的肩星，是一顆快死的星嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will blow up one day.
dialogue.zh: 總有一天它會爆發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That thought feels a little heavy.
dialogue.zh: 這樣想讓人有點沉重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Its light is old anyway.
dialogue.zh: 不過我們看到的是很久以前的光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the bright blue foot?
dialogue.zh: 那只發藍色的亮腳是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rigel, hotter and far bigger.
dialogue.zh: 是參宿七，更熱也大得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the hunter faces a bull.
dialogue.zh: 所以獵戶面對著一頭公牛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Taurus is right above him.
dialogue.zh: 金牛座就在他的正上方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see a V of small faint stars.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ə vi əv smɔl feɪnt stɑrz./
dialogue.zh: 我看到一個V字，星星都很暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The Hyades, a loose open cluster.
dialogue.zh: 那是畢星團，鬆散的一群。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the red dot inside the V?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə rɛd dɑt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə vi?/
dialogue.zh: V裡面那個紅點是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a planet, not a star.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ˈplænɪt, nɑt ə stɑr./
dialogue.zh: 那是一顆行星，不是恆星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So Mars is parked in Taurus?
dialogue.zh: 所以這陣子火星停在金牛？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just this week, and quite high.
dialogue.zh: 就這幾天，而且掛得頗高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us find the W shape.
dialogue.zh: 我們來找那個W形。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cassiopeia sits opposite the dipper.
dialogue.zh: 仙后座在北斗的對面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It really looks like a chair.
dialogue.zh: 它真的很像一張椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A queen's chair, tipped on its side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kwɪnz tʃɛr, tɪpt ɑn ɪts saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 是王后的椅子，斜躺著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the Milky Way runs through it.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə ˈmɪlki weɪ rʌnz θru ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你看，銀河正好從中間穿過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look how the glow thickens there.
dialogue.zh: 你看那裡的光變得多濃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can see lanes in the light.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn si leɪnz ɪn ðə laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 光裡還有暗的小路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dark dust between us and far stars.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑrk dʌst bɪtˈwin ʌs ænd fɑr stɑrz./
dialogue.zh: 是我們與遠星之間的黑塵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me the binoculars back.
dialogue.zh: 把雙筒望遠鏡還我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweep the horizon, slow, side to side.
dialogue.phonetic: /swip ðə həˈraɪzən, sloʊ, saɪd tə saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢掃過地平線，左右移動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something bright rose over the pines.
dialogue.zh: 松樹上方升起一個亮點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Jupiter. Our brightest guest tonight.
dialogue.zh: 木星，今晚最亮的客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It does not blink at all.
dialogue.zh: 它完全不會一閃一閃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Planets shine steady; stars flicker.
dialogue.zh: 行星的光很穩，恆星會眨眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do stars flicker, then?
dialogue.zh: 那星星為什麼會閃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Their thin light bends in moving air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr θɪn laɪt bɛndz ɪn ˈmuvɪŋ ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 它們細細的光，在流動的空氣裡彎折。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I see Jupiter's moons?
dialogue.zh: 我能看到木星的衛星嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steady the scope, then look close.
dialogue.zh: 扶穩鏡身，再仔細看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four little pearls in a line.
dialogue.zh: 四顆小珍珠排成一直線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They shift places within an hour.
dialogue.zh: 一小時內它們就會換位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a solar system at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ˈsoʊlər ˈsɪstəm æt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 在家門口就有一個星系。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tiny one, but real.
dialogue.zh: 很小，但千真萬確。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam, when did you start all this?
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm, wɛn dɪd ju stɑrt ɔl ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: Sam，你什麼時候開始看星的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At nine, with cheap binoculars.
dialogue.zh: 九歲那年，用的是很便宜的雙筒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You remember every single name.
dialogue.zh: 你記得每一個名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each one was a night like this.
dialogue.phonetic: /itʃ wʌn wʌz ə naɪt laɪk ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 每個名字都來自這樣的一夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slowly, the sky is teaching me.
dialogue.zh: 天空正在慢慢地教我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with five stars. Learn those well.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt wɪð faɪv stɑrz. lɜrn ðoʊz wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 先認五顆，把它們認熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: North star, dipper, Orion, Vega, Mars.
dialogue.zh: 北極星、北斗、獵戶、織女、火星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Vega is up there, blue and sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈviːɡə ɪz ʌp ðɛr, blu ænd ʃɑrp./
dialogue.zh: 織女在上面，藍而尖亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the very bright one, near Lyra?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈvɛri braɪt wʌn, nɪr ˈlaɪrə?/
dialogue.zh: 天琴座旁邊那顆很亮的星？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the summer triangle's tip.
dialogue.zh: 那是夏季大三角的一個角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see that white line?
dialogue.zh: 你看到那道白色的線了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! It crossed in one second.
dialogue.zh: 看到了！一秒就劃過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was a meteor, a shooting star.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz ə ˈmitiɔr, ə ˈʃutɪŋ stɑr./
dialogue.zh: 那是一顆流星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So tiny, yet so bright.
dialogue.zh: 那麼小，卻那麼亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is only dust from a comet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈoʊnli dʌst frʌm ə ˈkɑmət./
dialogue.zh: 它只是一顆彗星留下的塵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Burning up in our thin air.
dialogue.zh: 在我們的大氣裡燒掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How fast was that little grain?
dialogue.zh: 那粒小塵埃有多快？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Faster than any car on earth.
dialogue.zh: 比世上任何車子都快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the sky is raining light.
dialogue.zh: 你看，天空正在下著光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shower started earlier than planned.
dialogue.zh: 流星雨比預計的更早開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many did we count?
dialogue.zh: 我們數到幾顆了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I lost count after thirty.
dialogue.zh: 三十顆以後我就數亂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Me too. My neck is sore.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我脖子都痠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lie down and count from there.
dialogue.zh: 躺下來，靠著毯子接著數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A meteor just took your wish.
dialogue.zh: 那顆流星剛把你的願望帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did not even close my eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd nɑt ˈivɪn kloʊz maɪ aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我都還沒閉眼許願呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then make one now. They keep coming.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn meɪk wʌn naʊ. ðeɪ kip ˈkʌmɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那就現在許一個，它們還一直來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, one more for clear weather.
dialogue.zh: 好，再許一個天天晴朗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A green tail that time. See?
dialogue.zh: 這次尾巴是綠色的，看到沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe copper in all that dust.
dialogue.zh: 也許是塵裡的銅在發光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Colors come from the metal inside.
dialogue.zh: 顏色來自裡面含的金屬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Iron glows yellow, magnesium blue-white.
dialogue.zh: 鐵燒起來發黃光，鎂發藍白。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You know the colors too?
dialogue.zh: 你連顏色都知道？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I read one page every week.
dialogue.zh: 我每個星期只讀一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me the phone; let us try the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi ðə foʊn; lɛt ʌs traɪ ði æp./
dialogue.zh: 把手機給我，我們試試天文App。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it up and turn slowly.
dialogue.zh: 把它舉高，慢慢轉身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It names everything I point at.
dialogue.zh: 我指向哪裡，它就叫出名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It even draws the old myth lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈivɪn drɔz ði oʊld mɪθ laɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 它還把神話的線畫出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This red dot here is Mars.
dialogue.zh: 螢幕上這個紅點是火星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swipe to it. It tells how far.
dialogue.phonetic: /swaɪp tə ɪt. ɪt tɛlz haʊ fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 滑過去，它會告訴你多遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hundred million kilometers.
dialogue.zh: 兩億公里遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light still takes twelve minutes.
dialogue.zh: 光還是要走十二分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturn! Where is Saturn? App, help.
dialogue.zh: 土星！土星在哪？App幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low in the west, by that thin cloud.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ ɪn ðə wɛst, baɪ ðæt θɪn klaʊd./
dialogue.zh: 低低在西邊，那片薄雲旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A ring around a small pale ball.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə rɪŋ əˈraʊnd ə smɔl peɪl bɔl./
dialogue.zh: 一顆淡色小球周圍有環。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Switch to the middle power now.
dialogue.zh: 現在換中等倍率看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see a handle on both sides.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ə ˈhændəl ɑn boʊθ saɪdz./
dialogue.zh: 我看到兩邊各有一個把手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those are the rings, wide open now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz ɑr ðə rɪŋz, waɪd ˈoʊpən naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那就是土星環，現在張得很開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They look glued to the planet.
dialogue.zh: 看起來像黏在行星上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They float far out, in pieces.
dialogue.zh: 其實飄在很遠的地方，一塊一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pieces how big? Like pebbles?
dialogue.zh: 碎片有多大？像石子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From dust to houses, all ice.
dialogue.zh: 從塵土一直到房子那麼大，全是冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How can something float like that?
dialogue.zh: 怎麼可能那樣飄著不掉下來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gravity keeps them in a path.
dialogue.zh: 重力把它們留在固定路徑上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even the gap in the rings has a name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ðə ɡæp ɪn ðə rɪŋz hæz ə neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 連環裡那道縫隙都有名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cassini's division. The app says so.
dialogue.zh: App 上寫卡西尼縫隙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A man named a gap in the sky.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə mæn neɪmd ə ɡæp ɪn ðə skaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 有人為天上的一道縫命名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He used a lens much like ours.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi juzd ə lɛnz mʌtʃ laɪk ˈaʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 他用的鏡片跟我們的很像。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, a time clock is at the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ə taɪm klɑk ɪz æt ðə ˈbɑtəm./
dialogue.zh: 噢，底下還有一個時間軸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide it to watch them move.
dialogue.zh: 拖一下就能看到它們移動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hour later, Saturn is lower.
dialogue.zh: 一小時後，土星變低了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours and it touches the trees.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu aʊərz ænd ɪt ˈtʌtʃɪz ðə triz./
dialogue.zh: 兩小時後它就會碰到樹梢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let us look before it dips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt ʌs lʊk bɪˈfɔr ɪt dɪps./
dialogue.zh: 那我們就在它下沉前好好看它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thing we aimed early.
dialogue.zh: 還好我們很早就對準了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It also lists tonight's events.
dialogue.zh: 它還列出今晚的事件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen: a comet, an eclipse, a launch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən: ə ˈkɑmət, ən ɪˈklɪps, ə lɔntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 你聽：彗星、食、還有一次發射。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A launch? From where exactly?
dialogue.zh: 發射？從哪裡發射？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the desert, next week at dusk.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ðə ˈdɛzərt, nɛkst wik æt dʌsk./
dialogue.zh: 下週傍晚，從沙漠基地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we drive out for that?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以開車去現場看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can plan it right now.
dialogue.zh: 我們現在就可以排進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This app knows just where we stand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs æp noʊz dʒʌst wɛr wi stænd./
dialogue.zh: 這個App連我們站在哪裡都知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It uses the compass, so keep it flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈjuzɪz ðə ˈkʌmpəs, soʊ kip ɪt flæt./
dialogue.zh: 它用指南針，所以要拿平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are shaking from cold.
dialogue.zh: 我的手冷得在抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the phone down and clap twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə foʊn daʊn ænd klæp twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 先放下手機，拍兩下手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hand me the thermos, then.
dialogue.zh: 把保溫瓶遞給我吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is one cup left for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz wʌn kʌp lɛft fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 還剩一杯，留給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, the moon washed out the faint stars.
dialogue.phonetic: /si, ðə muːn wɑʃt aʊt ðə feɪnt stɑrz./
dialogue.zh: 你看，月亮把暗星都洗掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But now the craters get interesting.
dialogue.zh: 不過隕石坑現在最好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch the line where light meets shadow.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðə laɪn wɛr laɪt mits ˈʃædoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 看那條光明與黑暗的交界。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mountains throw their longest shapes there.
dialogue.zh: 山在那裡拉出最長的影子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the moon has no air at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə muːn hæz noʊ ɛr æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 而且月亮上沒有空氣，也沒有天氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So footprints stay for a million years.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈfʊtˌprɪnts steɪ fər ə ˈmɪljən jɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 所以腳印可以留百萬年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the quietest place I know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈkwaɪətɪst pleɪs aɪ noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那是我知道最安靜的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing erases anything there.
dialogue.zh: 那裡什麼都不會抹去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the whole field looks silver.
dialogue.zh: 現在整片草地看起來是銀色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can pack without any light.
dialogue.zh: 不用燈我們也能收東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look back once more at Saturn.
dialogue.zh: 再回頭看一眼土星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturn, low in the west, still shining.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætɜrn, loʊ ɪn ðə wɛst, stɪl ˈʃaɪnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 土星還掛在西邊低空，靜靜地亮著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want a picture of the moon.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ə ˈpɪktʃər əv ðə muːn./
dialogue.zh: 我想幫那個月亮拍張照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the phone still on the eyepiece.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə foʊn stɪl ɑn ði ˈaɪˌpis./
dialogue.zh: 把手機穩穩貼住目鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My elbow shakes the whole picture.
dialogue.zh: 我的手肘讓整張畫面都在晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest your wrist on the tube here.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst jɔr rɪst ɑn ðə tub hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 手腕靠在鏡筒上就穩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it! A small gray ball.
dialogue.zh: 拍到了！一顆灰色的小圓球。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the timer, then breathe out.
dialogue.zh: 按下倒數，然後把氣吐出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better. I can see dark seas.
dialogue.zh: 好多了，我看到暗色的海。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those are old lava plains, actually.
dialogue.zh: 其實那是古老的熔岩平原。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next, Jupiter with its four moons.
dialogue.zh: 接著拍木星和它的四顆衛星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set ten seconds and keep steady.
dialogue.zh: 設十秒倒數，身體別搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four dots. Blurry, but there.
dialogue.zh: 四個點，有點糊，但在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very good for a first night.
dialogue.zh: 第一次看，這樣已經很棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: App calls this page a sky diary.
dialogue.phonetic: /æp kɔlz ðɪs peɪdʒ ə skaɪ ˈdaɪəri./
dialogue.zh: App把這頁叫做星空日記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It counts every star you found.
dialogue.zh: 它會數你一共找到幾顆星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did not know stars could be counted.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd nɑt noʊ stɑrz kʊd bi ˈkaʊntɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我都不知道星星還能計數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You saved a hundred stars tonight.
dialogue.zh: 你今晚存了一百顆星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam is packing his tripod now.
dialogue.zh: Sam正在收拾他的三腳架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says the best is still coming.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz ðə bɛst ɪz stɪl ˈkʌmɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 他說最好的一段還沒來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the peak is near two o'clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə pik ɪz nɪr tu əˈklɑk./
dialogue.zh: 而高峰期大約在兩點前後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we sit and simply watch.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就坐著專心看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No more screens for a while.
dialogue.zh: 一會兒都不再看螢幕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the dark and the falling light.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə dɑrk ænd ðə ˈfɔlɪŋ laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 只剩下黑夜和落下的光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wind finds every gap in my jacket.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪnd faɪndz ˈɛvri ɡæp ɪn maɪ ˈdʒækɪt./
dialogue.zh: 風從外套的縫隙一直鑽進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take my coat. It is warmer.
dialogue.zh: 穿我的那件，比較暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about you? You will freeze.
dialogue.zh: 那你呢？你會凍壞的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two pairs of socks and a hat.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu pɛrz ʌv sɑks ænd ə hæt./
dialogue.zh: 我穿了兩雙襪子，還有帽子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam left us his folding chair.
dialogue.zh: Sam把折疊椅留給我們了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says his back needs a bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz hɪz bæk nidz ə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 他說他的腰撐不住了，要先回去睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we take his chair back over?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi teɪk hɪz tʃɛr bæk ˈoʊvər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要把他的椅子送過去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not now. This seat is ours tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt naʊ. ðɪs sit ɑrz ˈaʊərz təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 待會兒再說，這座位今晚是我們自己的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hand me the blanket from the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /hænd mi ðə ˈblæŋkɪt frʌm ðə kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 把車裡的毯子遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red one, or the wool one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛd wʌn, ɔr ðə wʊl wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 紅色的那條，還是毛的那條？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wool, please. It holds heat better.
dialogue.zh: 要毛毯那條，它比較保溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wrap your feet, then your shoulders.
dialogue.zh: 先把腳包住，再裹住肩膀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot cocoa is almost gone.
dialogue.zh: 熱可可快見底了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last two sips are yours.
dialogue.zh: 最後兩口都留給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can a field be this cold?
dialogue.zh: 一塊草地可以這麼冷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fields lose their heat all night long.
dialogue.phonetic: /fildz luz ðɛr hit ɔl naɪt lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 草地會把熱一整夜都散光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our car breathes out white clouds.
dialogue.zh: 我們的車呼出白色的霧氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Its seats still keep some warmth.
dialogue.zh: 座位還有點餘溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us leave the doors open.
dialogue.zh: 我們把車門開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only one, so the heat stays.
dialogue.zh: 只開一邊，熱才留得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look up. Be quiet for once.
dialogue.zh: 抬頭看，難得安靜一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The Milky Way is a river now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɪlki weɪ ɪz ə ˈrɪvər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 銀河現在是一條河。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can see its banks and bends.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn si ɪts bæŋkz ænd bɛndz./
dialogue.zh: 我看得到河岸和彎道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And dark patches in the river.
dialogue.zh: 還有一塊一塊河裡的暗斑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cygnus swims down the middle.
dialogue.zh: 天鵝座順著河中央游下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A long cross with a bright eye.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lɔŋ krɔs wɪð ə braɪt aɪ./
dialogue.zh: 一個長十字，中間有亮眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is that bright star, way up there?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðæt braɪt stɑr, weɪ ʌp ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 那顆高高的好亮的星是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Vega winks at us from there.
dialogue.zh: 織女在那裡朝我們眨眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And over there, a great square.
dialogue.zh: 那邊還有一個大方框。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pegasus, the winged horse's body.
dialogue.zh: 飛馬座，長翅膀那匹馬的身軀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two faint fish swim below it.
dialogue.zh: 兩條小魚在它下面遊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pisces. Hard to find, but there.
dialogue.zh: 雙魚座，很難找，但真的在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found the little goat myself.
dialogue.zh: 那只小山羊是我自己找到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Capella, high and quite yellow.
dialogue.zh: 五車二，又高又偏黃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that sun have planets too?
dialogue.zh: 那顆太陽也有行星嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe. We cannot see them yet.
dialogue.zh: 也許有，只是我們還看不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every dot here is a sun.
dialogue.zh: 每一顆點都是一個太陽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And each may hide a world of its own.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd itʃ meɪ haɪd ə wərld əv ɪts oʊn./
dialogue.zh: 而每一顆，可能也藏著自己的世界。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel warm inside somehow.
dialogue.zh: 不知為何，我心裡是暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small, but part of all this.
dialogue.zh: 很小，但也是這一切的一部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone says it is almost two.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn sɛz ɪt ɪz əˈmoʊst tu./
dialogue.zh: 手機顯示快兩點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more meteor round, then we go.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ˈmitiɔr raʊnd, ðɛn wi ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 再看一輪流星就回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come lie down beside me here.
dialogue.zh: 過來，躺在我身邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blanket is dry under us.
dialogue.zh: 毯子在我們下面還是乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A falling star just missed the moon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfɔlɪŋ stɑr dʒʌst mɪst ðə muːn./
dialogue.zh: 那顆流星剛好擦過月亮旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It made the whole sky jump.
dialogue.zh: 那一下讓整片天都跳了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is another. And one more.
dialogue.zh: 又來一顆，還有一顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one was orange and slow.
dialogue.zh: 這顆是橘色的，慢慢落下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can point with my nose now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn pɔɪnt wɪð maɪ noʊz naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 躺著的我，現在只能用鼻尖指星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your voice is getting softer too.
dialogue.zh: 你的聲音也越來越輕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us take one photo together.
dialogue.zh: 我們合拍一張照吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Face the phone, not my red light.
dialogue.phonetic: /feɪs ðə foʊn, nɑt maɪ rɛd laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對著手機，別對著我的紅燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A group picture under all this.
dialogue.zh: 在滿天星星底下拍一張合照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam will laugh at our red faces.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm wɪl læf æt ˈaʊər rɛd ˈfeɪsəz./
dialogue.zh: Sam一定會笑我們的紅臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Red faces are the honest kind.
dialogue.zh: 紅色的臉最誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Timer set. Say the dark sky.
dialogue.zh: 倒數設好了，喊「黑夜空」。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We look so sleepy and happy.
dialogue.zh: 我們看起來又睏又開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the true face of stargazing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə tru feɪs ʌv ˈstɑrˌɡeɪzɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那就是看星星的真實表情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thermos cap is still warm inside.
dialogue.zh: 保溫瓶的蓋子裡還有溫度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One last sip for the road.
dialogue.zh: 最後一小口，留著上路喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fold the blanket while I wait.
dialogue.zh: 我等的時候你把毯子摺好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It folds smaller than it looks.
dialogue.zh: 它摺起來比看起來小得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tubes are capped and safe in boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʊbz ɑr kæpt ænd seɪf ɪn ˈbɑksɪz./
dialogue.zh: 鏡筒都蓋好、穩穩放進箱子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get the lantern and sweep the ground.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt ðə ˈlæntərn ænd swip ðə ɡraʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 把營燈拿來照一遍地面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found a lens cap here.
dialogue.zh: 我在這裡找到一個鏡蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was your missing one, yes.
dialogue.zh: 對，那就是你弄丟的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stars will stay after we leave.
dialogue.zh: 我們走了，星星還會留在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They do not need us at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ du nɑt nid ʌs æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 它們一點都不需要我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is strangely calming, you know.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，這樣想反而安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sky keeps working while we sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skaɪ kips ˈwɜrkɪŋ waɪl wi slip./
dialogue.zh: 我們睡著時，天空還在運作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You drive us home, okay? My eyes are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju draɪv ʌs hoʊm, oʊˈkeɪ? maɪ aɪz ɑr dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 你載我們回家，好嗎？我眼睛撐不住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. I will take it slow, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr. aɪ wɪl teɪk ɪt sloʊ, ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 好，那我就慢慢開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This car smells like cold air now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs kɑr smɛlz laɪk koʊld ɛr naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 車裡聞起來像外面的冷空氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And cocoa, and a little smoke.
dialogue.zh: 還有可可味，和一點煙味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So tired, all at once now.
dialogue.zh: 睏意突然一起湧上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest your eyes. We are nearly home.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst jɔr aɪz. wi ɑr ˈnɪrli hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 閉一下眼，我們快到家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Moon rides along with us home.
dialogue.zh: 月亮陪著我們一路到家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It waits for us at that hill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt weɪts fɔr ʌs æt ðæt hɪl./
dialogue.zh: 它會在我們家旁那座山頭等我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wake me if the sky clears more.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪk mi ɪf ðə skaɪ klɪrz mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 如果天更晴，就叫醒我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sleep. It is already clear.
dialogue.zh: 你睡吧，天空已經很清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time bring the camp stove.
dialogue.zh: 下次把那個爐子也帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a bigger pot for the cocoa.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ə ˈbɪɡər pɑt fər ðə ˈkoʊkoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 還有一個煮可可的大壺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will write tonight's date down.
dialogue.zh: 我要把今晚的日期寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the notebook by your bed?
dialogue.zh: 寫在床邊那本筆記裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes. I like to plan ahead.
dialogue.zh: 對，我喜歡提前排好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will add the next moonless night.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl æd ðə nɛkst ˈmuːnləs naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 下一個沒有月亮的夜晚，我也加進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the town lights are back.
dialogue.zh: 你看，城鎮的燈光又回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly, our stars fade from view.
dialogue.zh: 我們的星星，一顆顆淡出視野。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soon we will not see them.
dialogue.zh: 再一下就看不到它們了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But they are still up there.
dialogue.zh: 但它們仍然在高處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to keep this feeling close.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə kip ðɪs ˈfilɪŋ kloʊs./
dialogue.zh: 我想把這個感覺留在身邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And we will, on the next dark night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wi wɪl, ɑn ðə nɛkst dɑrk naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 會的，下一個暗夜我們再回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say good night to all this.
dialogue.zh: 對著這整片夜空說晚安。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night to every quiet star.
dialogue.zh: 晚安，每一顆安靜的星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are home now. Whisper, please.
dialogue.zh: 到家了，小聲說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bed is warm, the window dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛd ɪz wɔrm, ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 床是暖的，窗外是暗的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last star on the window glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst stɑr ɑn ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 窗玻璃上還有最後一顆星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The north star, right where it was.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nɔrθ stɑr, raɪt wɛr ɪt wʌz./
dialogue.zh: 是北極星，還在原本的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep now, the sky will turn.
dialogue.zh: 睡吧，天空會自己轉動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close your eyes, and drift with it.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz jɔr aɪz, ænd drɪft wɪð ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 閉上眼，跟著它慢慢飄。
